device.soc: ALi M3510A (M3503 family with cache-as-RAM bootloader)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.2.0), MemCfg 0x01E800, padding 0x01F800, maincode chunk -- 4 MB flash

source.note: Opticum AX 300 official Polish firmware update.

simulator.note: Boots as M3503: initializes cache-as-RAM stack, unpacks maincode, prints 'model = 27:AX300', 'ALI3510E AX300' and 'MC: APP  init ok'.

desc: The V1.09.13196 Polish firmware for the Opticum AX 300 satellite receiver based on the cost-reduced ALi M3510A/E SoC.
Uses an FD650K front panel and internal DVB-S2 demodulator.
